column1: # Shared billing configuration cases (#2033, spec section 11, R9).
# every row through [internal]check-billing-env.sh. Both must give
# Columns are separated by one TAB: name, outcome, expect, then zero or more
# NAME=value assignments. Unlisted variables are unset. NAME= sets an empty
# value, which both readers treat as unset.
#   outcome ok: accepted. expect is a substring of the success summary
#   outcome fatal: refused. expect is a substring of the Go error and of the
#   values: \r, \n and \t stand for CR, LF and TAB. No other backslash may
#     appear. Literal spaces are kept; never end a line with one.
# No field may be empty: the shell reader collapses adjacent TABs.
